hook: A single trapped ion was driven into Schrödinger cat states with two to five components.
summary: Physicists used one trapped ion's vibration, pushed into a strongly nonlinear regime, to create cat states with two, three, four and five components. They did it with a new form of engineered dissipation and then measured the states. This is a proof of principle on one ion, and its use for error correction or sensing is still prospective.
title: Nonlinear cooling and control of a mechanical quantum harmonic oscillator.
